films.refused: Ceph-400 test2 and Aariz test, before anything is read

shape.reference: models/shape/ceph400-v1.shape (shape-prior/2, the 300 tracings Stage A uses)
shape.folds: Test1 ids sorted, shuffled with splitmix64 seed 20261103; fold i = positions 30i..30i+29 (5 folds); a Test1 film is judged by the 150 Train tracings plus the other four folds (270); Aariz valid films by all 300
shape.line: nearest-rank 99.5th percentile of the reference set's leave-one-out D2, rounded up to 0.1, for the points present

gate.control: C9: the hold-out's boxes inflated 2x trip the gate

regions.rule: a point is outside when it is off the film, or its region's box was found and distance-outside / longer side > tau_r; fewer than 3 of 5 regions found: no-ceph-found
regions.gateReport: reports/sc1/box-gate-2.json, version sc1-box-gate/2, verdict pass, controlTripped true, its detectorFingerprint, scoreLine and tau equal to the values above
regions.refusedV1: the sc1-box-gate/1 pair is refused before any SC1-1a film is read: reports/sc1/box-gate.json is never read, models/regions/calibration-1.json is never read, and a calibration.json with rule sc1-box-gate/1 (or no rule), another tau, score line, fingerprint or gate report SHA-256 stops the run (exit 1)

plants.rng: ft_common::case_rng(20261104, [type, film index, part]); P2's derangement: chainproof::Rng(20261104 ^ dataset salt)
plants.P1a: mirrored with the film: x -> width - 1 - x, the film's facing unchanged; 300
plants.P1b: mirrored in place about the tracing's centroid; 300
plants.P2: another film's tracing, coordinates as they are: a seeded single-cycle derangement within the same Test1 fold (so the planted tracing is never in the judged film's reference set) and within Aariz valid; 300
plants.P3: x0.5 and x2 about the tracing's centroid; 600
plants.P4: each of the 5 regions in turn, all its traced points moved d = 10 + 10u mm in direction 2*pi*v (u, v from the case rng); films with a recorded scale only: Ceph-400 test1 at 0.1 mm/px (150) and Aariz valid under aariz-scale/1 (98); 1,240

marks.caught: a planted tracing whose check is flagged for any reason
marks.falseAlarm: an untouched tracing whose check is flagged for any reason
marks.pooled: OQ-5: pooled; each type printed on its own line as information, no per-type floor

information: the whole tracing shifted 10 and 20 mm (seeded direction; scaled films only): flag rates
which look caught each plant (shape / region / facing / no-ceph-found)
whether Stage A (point-check/2, the same reference sets) flagged the plant too
the box-quality table on these 300 normal films (Ceph-400's expert boxes use only the 19 points)
each installed model's real runs from the caches given with --cache: flag rate, split by whether any point is more than 10 mm off; otherwise the line says no cache was given
notSeen: a wrong mm-per-pixel number with the points untouched (Part 1 never reads the scale, OQ-8): not planted, not counted

controls.C1: 50 SYNTHETIC faces mirrored about their centre, judged by a scorer of 300 SYNTHETIC faces: 50 of 50 mirrored
controls.C2: 10 control films' tracings x2: 10 of 10 region; the same unscaled: not all 10 flagged
controls.C3: the same 10 films' mandible region moved 40 mm forward: 10 of 10 region (mandible); unshifted: not all 10
controls.C4: the same 10 films flipped horizontally: the detector's facing flips on 10 of 10
controls.C5: test2 and Aariz test paths refused
controls.C6: the homework guard: a judged film planted into its own reference set is refused, nothing reported
controls.C7: every count equals its expected total; a mark that counted nothing is an error
controls.C8: the same 10 films' coordinates x1000: 10 of 10 region, every point off the film
controls.C9: carried from the gate report: control tripped
controls.controlFilms: 10 Test1 films: Test1 ids sorted, shuffled with ft_common::case_rng(20261104, [9]), the first 10

definitions.facing: every film's stored facing is right (facing_left false), as in the gate and the region probe; the check is called exactly as the app calls it
definitions.filmIndex: Test1 ids sorted are film indices 0-149; Aariz valid ids sorted are 150-299
definitions.types: case-rng type numbers: P4 5 (part = region index in the canonical order cranial base, maxilla, mandible, incisors, soft-tissue profile), the information shift 6 (part = 10 or 20, the shift in mm), the control films 9
definitions.draws: P4: u = (next >> 11) / 2^53 from the case rng, then the direction from ft_common::direction on the same stream (one number: angle 2*pi*v); the information shift: the direction only
definitions.centroid: the mean of the 19 traced points; P1b: x -> 2 cx - x; P3 and C2: p -> c + k (p - c); C8: each coordinate x1000 (about the film's origin)
definitions.mm: a shift of d mm is d / mm-per-px pixels: 0.1 mm/px on Ceph-400, the aariz-scale/1 value on an Aariz valid film; the check never reads it
definitions.salts: P2's dataset salt: 400 + fold index (0-4) for a Ceph-400 Test1 fold (one derangement per fold, over the fold's ids in fold order); 1 for Aariz valid (over its ids sorted). Sattolo: for i from n-1 down to 1, swap i with Rng.below(i)
definitions.boxes: the region finder runs once per film on the film as stored (cached by detector fingerprint, reports/sc1/boxes); every plant of a film is judged against that film's boxes at the score line; C4's 10 films are run again flipped, and their facing read in the flipped film
definitions.C1: reference: ceph_model synthetic faces(300, seed 20261103); judged: faces(50, seed 20261104) on a 2000 x 2400 SYNTHETIC film, mirrored x -> 1999 - x; shape look only (no region model); 'mirrored' = the reason mirrored
definitions.C3: forward = +x (the films face right); 40 mm = 400 px at Ceph-400's 0.1 mm/px
definitions.stageA: point-check/2 score_run with a ShapeScorer of the same reference tracings (fold-held-out on Test1); flagged = Flagged or FilmUnusual; information only
definitions.caught: flagged = the whole-film check's result is Flagged (any reason); Clean and NotRun are not flagged

disclosure: SC1-1a's normal films were passed through the region finder once, by sc1-box-gate/1's information table (box agreement only, no flags computed); no threshold was set from them.

tau and the calibration come from sc1-box-gate/2 (owner ruling 5 Nov 2026, 'Set from both sets'): the Aariz-train hold-out and Ceph-400 Train 001-150, neither an SC1-1a film; the region probe sc1-region-probe/1 is therefore not independent evidence, and these 300 normal films are the only false-alarm measure that counts.
the Test1 films are in the shipped shape reference (300 tracings); the folds above keep each judged Test1 film out of its own reference set
requires: reports/sc1/box-gate-2.json (sc1-box-gate/2) with verdict pass, its SHA-256 and fingerprint as pinned above; models/regions/calibration.json with rule sc1-box-gate/2, equal to scoreLine and tau above

verdicts.pass: caught >= 2603 of 2740 and false alarms <= 6 of 300, controls hold -> exit 0, Part 1 may ship
verdicts.fail: controls hold, a mark missed -> exit 3, back to the owner, no re-run with new marks
verdicts.broken: a control fails, a count is off, or the gate report is missing or broken -> exit 1, nothing concluded
verdicts.gateStop: the gate report's verdict is stop -> exit 4, no verdict, SC1-1a not failed, to the owner
